points: In the twenty-fifth year of the captivity, the hand of the Lord is upon Ezekiel and brings him in the visions of God into the land of Israel, setting him on a very high mountain where he sees the frame of a city.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: A man whose appearance is like brass stands in the gate with a line of flax and a measuring reed in his hand. This is an angel, and he tells Ezekiel to behold with his eyes, hear with his ears, and set his heart on all that is shown, to declare it to the house of Israel.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: There is a wall on the outside of the house round about, and the man holds a measuring reed of six cubits long. He measures the breadth of the building one reed and the height one reed. That comes to about nine feet tall and nine feet thick.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: The angel goes to the gate that looks toward the east, the outer court, and goes up its stairs. He measures the threshold one reed broad, the little chambers one reed long and one reed broad, and five cubits between the little chambers, which is about seven and a half feet.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: He measures the porch of the gate, the posts, and the entry, so the gate would be about fifteen feet wide and nineteen and a half feet long. The little chambers are three on each side, all of one measure, with narrow windows, arches, and palm trees on the posts throughout.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: Ezekiel is brought into the outward court, where there are chambers and a pavement made round about, thirty chambers upon the pavement. He measures a hundred cubits from the lower gate to the inner gate eastward and northward.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: The north gate and the south gate are measured after the same pattern as the east gate, fifty cubits long and twenty-five broad, with little chambers, arches, palm trees, and seven steps to go up to each.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: He brings Ezekiel to the inner court through the south gate, measured according to the same measures, fifty cubits long and twenty-five broad, with its chambers, posts, arches, windows, and palm trees, and eight steps to go up.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: The east gate and the north gate of the inner court are measured the same way, each with eight steps, showing the whole inner court laid out to one consistent pattern.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: The chambers and entries by the posts of the gates are where they wash the burnt offering. In the porch of the gate are two tables on each side to slay the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: There are eight tables in all where they slay the sacrifices, four of hewn stone for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half square and one cubit high. Hooks are fastened round about, and upon the tables is the flesh of the offering.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: Outside the inner gates are the chambers of the singers in the inner court. The chamber facing south is for the priests who keep the charge of the house, and the chamber facing north is for the priests who keep the charge of the altar, the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, who come near the Lord to minister.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: The court is measured a hundred cubits square, with the altar before the house. Ezekiel is brought to the porch of the house, its posts and gate measured, the porch twenty cubits long and eleven broad, with pillars by the posts and steps going up to it.
